react_native_issues.issue: React-Native-Web deprecation warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' emitted on every render of the app shell. Pre-existing, not caused by this feature but should be migrated. Reference: global (visible on every screen load, e.g. /employee-approvals).

Console error: 'Invalid style property of "padding". Value is "0 8px" but only single values are supported.' React Native does not accept CSS-shorthand strings for padding. Some component uses padding: '0 8px'. Pre-existing global issue, should be split into paddingHorizontal/paddingVertical. Reference: emitted on every screen load.

action_items: (Optional / pre-existing) Migrate 'shadow*' style props to 'boxShadow' to silence RN-Web deprecation warnings.
(Optional / pre-existing) Replace CSS-shorthand padding value 'padding: 0 8px' with paddingHorizontal/paddingVertical to eliminate console error on every render.
